day.headline: A Tiger day — Horse and Dog are in step.

reasons: Horse and Tiger share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Twenty minutes before they lock the doors. Go, move fast.

signs.message: Two minutes on the board. Run it, don't overthink the gap.
